subject: Kickoff: MSA & Order Form for Aptus Labs — initial asks and signer path
messages:
From: Nina Shah <nina.shah@aptuslabs.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@aptuslabs.com
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff for Aptus Labs

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Were ready to start contracting for our pilot (Aptus Labs x Redwood) and want to get the MSA + order form process moving. High-level context:

- Pilot: 3-month proof-of-value, US + UK tenants, expected 2k monthly active tokens.
- Procurement preference: standard MSA with an attached order form; Aptus needs a PO-friendly order form line items and a countersign path that supports a UK subsidiary signatory.

Initial asks so legal can scope redlines:
1) Please confirm which MSA template Redwood prefers for commercial customers (standard template or enterprise variant).
2) Well need a short exhibit for data residency and processing (UK data subject population).
3) SOC 2 evidence (latest report) + retention of audit logs — well add these to our security intake.
4) PO/Invoice flow and any required billing contacts for order forms.

Target timeline: wed like an initial redline pass within 10 business days if possible. If there are gating items (e.g., residency carveouts) point them out and we can prioritize.

Attaching: Aptus_PO_terms.pdf (outline of purchasing terms our procurement uses).

Can you loop in the Redwood legal/contracting contact and advise next steps?

Thanks,

--
Nina Shah
Head of Procurement | Aptus Labs
procurement@aptuslabs.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Nina Shah <nina.shah@aptuslabs.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff for Aptus Labs

Hi Nina 
(continued)

Appreciate the detail — welcome aboard. Ive looped in Kimberly (Contracts) and Marissa (Onboarding) to own intake and the first redline pass. Quick responses to your asks and next steps: 

- Template: We typically start from our commercial MSA (standard template). For UK entities we use the enterprise variant only if there are material residency or indemnity changes. Kimberly, please confirm if well propose the standard template or escalate to enterprise for Aptus.
- Exhibit: Well draft a Data Processing & Residency Exhibit that calls out UK tenant routing and the limited carveouts we support.
- SOC 2 & logs: Ive asked Kimberly to attach our latest SOC 2 report and a short evidence packet.
- Billing/PO: Marissa will sync the order form line items to match the pilot scope and confirm invoicing contacts.

Attachments: Aptus_Party_Sheet.xlsx (requested party details), Aptus_MSA_Initial_redline.docx (preliminary notes Im sending to Contracts).

Proposed timeline: initial contracting intake + redline draft from Contracts by EOD (three business days). If there are UK-specific legal questions well flag them and request a short review window.

Next steps for you: please complete the party sheet (contacts, legal entities for US and UK, billing address, PO requirements) and return to me or Kimberly by tomorrow EOD if possible. That will unblock the redline.

Im available for a 20-min sync if youd prefer to walk through the party/PO details.

Cheers,

--
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-04T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MSA + Order Form kickoff for Aptus Labs — intake + priority items

Kimberly / Marissa — forwarding Aptus intake. Short internal notes and priorities so contracting can triage: 

Quoted original message below for context.

Priority items for the first redline pass (please treat #1-3 as blockers):
1) Signatory path & authority: Aptus needs UK subsidiary signatory support + US PO flow. Confirm whether we need an entity annex or signature matrix.
2) Data residency exhibit: UK tenant routing + data processing terms; call out subprocessor list and residency carveouts.
3) SOC 2 & logs: provide SOC 2 link/packet and sample log-retention language.
4) Payment & PO terms: align order form line items for a pilot and confirm whether net-30 or PO-based invoicing is required.
5) Indemnity caps: check if Aptus will push materially different caps — escalate to Legal if so.

Attachments I added to the intake folder: DocuSign-AuthPath.pdf (Aptuss proposed signature authority matrix they provided verbally in the intake call), Aptus_Party_Sheet.xlsx, Aptus_MSA_Initial_redline.docx.

Timeline: can we target a redline draft back to me and the Aptus procurement contact within 3 business days (by 2026-08-07 COB)? If anything needs Sales escalation (credits, SLA exceptions) flag in the document and copy me.

Thanks — feel free to ping me on Slack or call if you want to triage live.

--
Rafael
